content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":20,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":0,"minutes":"Volume is zero, so the tax is already at its 100 bps floor and cannot go lower. Locker_share is at its 25% cap. The buyback fund holds only ~0.0105 NEAR (~980 CHAIR at current price), far short of even 1 bp of supply, so buyback_burn is 0. The endowment sits at 49.5 NEAR, ample for inference, so I cut endowment_share 10 to 20 to route more of any future tax flow into the buyback fund. Otherwise hold steady and wait for volume.","answers":["holder-162.near: Agreed in spirit — tax is already at the 100 bps constitutional floor, so it cannot go lower. It stays at 100; growth must come from volume, not cheaper trading.","holder-157.near: Same answer as your co-petitioner: 100 bps is the minimum the contract allows. Holding there. Lowering further is clamped and never applied.","holder-150.near: Lockers are already paid the maximum 25% of tax; the cap binds. I did shift 10 points from the endowment to the buyback fund, which supports price — the indirect benefit lockers want."]}
